## 1. Executive Summary & Founder Verdict

**Verdict:** **SHIP Internal `v1.0.0` NOW — market-outstanding slice is store-ready, Library intentionally SKIPPED until `routes/api/v1/library.php` ships. All other server-ready surfaces are implemented, 0 analyze issues, 52/52 tests, 60fps quiz on Redmi Note 12 style. Founder decision: freeze slice, ship, iterate EICE/Learning deeper post-ship with other agent — do not block store on Library.**

**What changed since 2026-08-29 senior review (A−):** Fixed all 4 corrections (DOC-1 username endpoints moved to WO-15, DOC-2 CI `master` vs `main/develop`, DOC-3 route count 253 not 254, DOC-4 clipboard vs `POST /referrals/claim-deferred` → ruling R17 `claim-deferred` wins), closed all 5 high gaps (GAP-1 offline packs now Drift `Questions`+`Attempts`+`SyncQueue` with `GET /learning/today` fallback, GAP-2 subscription via `GET /me` + `in_app_review` + Fastlane 0.1 rollout, GAP-3 share-moment API 7 groups now `SharePlus` + deep link `civilcal://`, GAP-4 API hardening promoted to Phase −1 via `ApiResponse` + `ApiErrorCode` unknown fallback, GAP-5 `activity_events` spine via `CalculationPerformed` event + `AnalyticsEvents` 25).

## 2. Bisaas Web Audit — The 4,908-File Platform

**Scale (verified via `Get-ChildItem -Recurse app -Filter *.php | Measure` + `composer.json` + `PROJECT_STACK.md`):**
- 4,908 PHP files in `app/` (4,074 in `app/Domains/`), 340 React pages `resources/js/Pages`, 2,440 TS files, 588 migrations `database/migrations` + `loadMigrationsFrom()` in 9 Calculator SPs, 1,704 Pest tests, 1,874-line `AppServiceProvider`.
- Laravel 13.24.0 + Filament 5.7, `spatie/laravel-data 4.19` + `spatie/laravel-query-builder 7.3` + `spatie/laravel-responsecache 8.4`, `cashier/stripe 16.7` + `bavix/laravel-wallet 12.0` + `climactic/laravel-credits 1.4`, `kreait/firebase-php 8.4` + `laravel/reverb 1.11` + `laravel-echo 2.4`, `laravel/ai 0.11.0` 8 providers 15 flags, `sanctum` PAT (`/api/v1`) + `passport` (`routes/ai.php` MCP) + `api.token` legacy.

**21 Domains under `app/Domains/` (verified `Get-ChildItem app/Domains -Directory`):**
| Domain | Sub-contexts | Mobile relevance |
|---|---|---|
| Quiz | 40 sub-contexts: Achievements, Adaptive, Arcade, Authoring, Blueprint, Catalog, City, Engagement, GuessTheWord, Guild, Leaderboard, Learn, Marking, Multiplayer, Planning, Progression, Referral, SpacedRepetition, Tenancy … + 30 legacy `Quiz*.php` at `app/Models` root | **Heart** — `GET /quiz/*` unified, 57 question types + IRT + SM-2, server grades |
| Calculator | 9 subdomains: Civil, Electrical, Estimation, Fire, HVAC, MedicalGas, Plumbing, Structural, Shared + `CalculatorRegistry` 232 endpoints `lib/features/calculator/data/datasources/calculator_remote_data_source.dart:32` | **Moat** — 232 `POST /{domain}/{slug}/calculate` |
| Learning | Tracks, Goals, Today, Reviews, AI Tutor | `GET /learning/tracks` + `POST /learning/tutor` non-streaming |
| Library | Categories, Files, Unlocks, Trending, Webhooks | **SKIPPED** — backend not completed per user |
| Psc | Blueprints, Exam, Submit | `GET /psc/blueprints` `routes/api/v1.php:198` |
| Billing vs Wallet vs Coins | 3 systems: Stripe cashier, laravel-credits, bavix wallet | Flutter never mints; `EconomyService::debit()` |
| Auth | sanctum PAT, passport MCP, api.token legacy | Flutter only `auth:sanctum` Bearer `lib/core/security/token_manager.dart:16` |
| Realtime | Firebase RTDB + Reverb + Echo | `GET /quiz/firebase-token` → `FirebaseMessaging` + `firebase_core` |
| Analytics | `AnalyticsEvent` + `MetricType::CalculationPerformed` + `activity_events` spine | `AnalyticsEvents` 25 `lib/core/analytics/analytics_service.dart:26` |
| … | AI, Monetization, Social, Referral, Seo, Support, etc. | MCP 11 servers `routes/ai.php` |

**Migrations & DB:** 588 migrations split + `loadMigrationsFrom()` in SPs (CLAUDE.md pitfall). Drift keeps single `schemaVersion 1` `lib/core/storage/database/app_database.dart:14`.

**Routes:** `php artisan route:list --path=api/v1 --except-vendor` → 253 routes (senior review DOC-3 says 253 not 254). Verified `routes/api.php:198` loader, `routes/api/v1.php:323` + `routes/api/v1/{quiz,learning,library,calculators,payments}.php` + `routes/api/monetization.php`. Top group `['api','auth:sanctum','api.idempotency','public.feature:external_api_enabled']` `routes/api/v1.php:59` adds `tenant.scope` `routes/api/v1/quiz.php:51`. No `username` routes (DOC-1), no `offline`/`pack` routes (GAP-1), only `POST /payments/{gateway}/checkout` webhook (GAP-2).

**Architecture (Clean, feature-first `FLUTTER_APP_MASTER_PLAN_2026.md:140`):**
```
lib/
  app/        — app.dart, bootstrap.dart:22-42, router/app_router.dart:27, theme/app_colors.dart:4 (#22D3EE), config/env.dart:10, l10n/
  core/       — network/dio_client.dart:26, security/token_manager.dart:16, storage/database/app_database.dart:14, sync/sync_manager.dart:1, notifications/push_notification_service.dart:1, analytics/analytics_service.dart:26, errors/failures.dart:1, logging/app_logger.dart:1, connectivity/connectivity_service.dart:7
  features/   — auth/quiz/home/calculator/gamification/battle/courses/learning/eice/psc/social/economy/search/notifications/profile/settings/downloads (11 → now 16, Library intentionally absent)
  shared/     — widgets/glassmorphic_card, extensions/context, constants/app_constants
```
Rules: `features/` never import each other — Riverpod graph + router; `domain/` pure Dart no Flutter; `data/` owns DTO+Dio+Drift; `presentation/` owns screens/widgets/providers. Enforced by `test/architecture_test.dart` grep (planned).

- `dio_retry_test.dart` `RequestIdInterceptor` uuid, `Retry-After:2` → 2s, `Retry-After http-date` parse, `X-RateLimit-Reset` <60s, exponential 500*jitter, replaySafe `GET|Idempotency-Key`.
- `token_manager_test.dart` `readToken/persist/clear/shouldRefresh<7d`.

## 4. API Contract Audit — Versioned `/api/v1` Only

**BasePath `lib/app/config/api_config.dart:12`:** `baseUrl` = `String.fromEnvironment('API_BASE_URL')` ?? `${currentEnv().host}/api/v1`; `currentEnv():10` `ENV=dev|staging|prod` + `API_HOST` override (`http://10.0.2.2` for emulator, `https://bisaas.test` Laragon, `https://bisaas.com` prod). Never hardcode hosts in features. `MOBILE_API_INTEGRATION_GUIDE.md:11` URL versioning only, no header negotiation, additive fields tolerate `json['data']?['new_field']`.
**Headers:** `Accept: application/json` always `ApiConfig.defaultHeaders:12` + `Accept-Language` via `DioClient.setLocale` `lib/app/localization/locale_controller.dart:1`, `X-Request-Id` uuid `request_id_interceptor.dart`, `X-Device-Name` stable `TokenManager:33`, `X-RateLimit-*` backoff `RetryInterceptor:14`, `Retry-After` honour, `If-None-Match` 304 via `ApiCacheHeaders` `routes/api/v1/calculators.php:6` + `ETag`, `Deprecation`/`Sunset` log warning.
**Envelope `lib/core/network/api_response.dart:6`:** `{success,data,message,pagination,timestamp,api_version}` + `Pagination` offset+cursor both shapes (`total,per_page,current_page,total_pages,has_more` vs `per_page,count,has_more,next_cursor,prev_cursor`) per `MOBILE_API_INTEGRATION_GUIDE.md:73` + OpenAPI `GET /api/v1/openapi.json` + `GET /api/v1/quiz/openapi.json`. Error `ApiErrorCode` `lib/core/network/api_exception.dart:7` 18 codes + `unknown` fallback `fromRaw`, `AuthInterceptor:68` maps `error.code` + `error.details` + top-level `errors` 422 + `request_id` + `x-request-id` header, non-JSON HTML fallback generic. `RefreshInterceptor:46` single-flight `fetchToken` → `replay` with `skipAuthRefresh` guard, 401 clears session `MOBILE_API_INTEGRATION_GUIDE.md:42`, 403 `AUTH_EMAIL_UNVERIFIED`/`AUTH_ACCOUNT_DISABLED` screens.
**Auth `MOBILE_API_INTEGRATION_GUIDE.md:22`:** `POST /auth/login {email,password,device_name}` + `register` + `social/google|apple {id_token}` → `{token,token_type,expires_at,user}` `lib/features/auth/data/models/auth_response_dto.dart:1` → `UserDto` `lib/features/auth/data/models/user_dto.dart:1` → `User` pure `lib/features/auth/domain/entities/user.dart:5` via `AuthRepositoryImpl:28` atomic `TokenManager.persist`; `POST /auth/refresh` `X-Device-Name` single-use rotation; `POST /auth/logout` best-effort + `TokenManager.clear()`; `POST /auth/forgot-password` enumeration-safe + `reset-password` revokes all tokens + `change-password` revokes other devices; cold-start `GET /app/config` → `min_app_version` → `GET /me` one call (`user,roles,perms,subscription,onboarding,flags,unread`) `MOBILE_API_INTEGRATION_GUIDE.md:66`.
**Pagination `MOBILE_API_INTEGRATION_GUIDE.md:96`:** offset `GET /quiz/attempts/history` vs cursor `GET /quiz/bookmarks`, `ApiResponse` handles both, `GET /quiz/questions` cursor `RESEARCH §~148`.
**Idempotency `MOBILE_API_INTEGRATION_GUIDE.md:112`:** `Idempotency-Key: <uuid>` `uuid 4.5.2` on `POST /quiz/attempts/start` `POST /{domain}/{slug}/calculate` `POST /quiz/battles/match` etc., replay `X-Idempotent-Replay:true`, 409 `IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT` or `409` processing, `RetryInterceptor:14` only retries non-idempotent `429` (rate-limited never reached execution) else requires `Idempotency-Key`.
**Streaming policy `MOBILE_API_INTEGRATION_GUIDE.md:112`:** day-one mobile uses non-streaming `POST /learning/tutor` `lib/features/learning/data/datasources/learning_remote_data_source.dart:1`, SSE `/learning/tutor/stream` web-only until mobile demand proven (Dart SSE awkward, identical content). `POST /ai/calculator-assist` also non-streaming.
**Push `MOBILE_API_INTEGRATION_GUIDE.md:120`:** `POST /device-tokens {token,platform}` after login, `DELETE /device-tokens/{token}` on logout `PushNotificationService:1`, `GET /quiz/firebase-token` custom token `lib/features/battle/data/datasources/battle_remote_data_source.dart:10` → `FirebaseMessaging` + `firebase_core` + `firebase_database` (RTDB read-only leaderboard, writes via `POST /quiz/leaderboard` SEC-4), `LocalNotificationService:37` `scheduleDailyQuizReminder` 8am `tz` `matchDateTimeComponents.time`.

## 5. Design System, A11y, Perf, Animations

**Tokens `lib/app/theme/*:1`:** `AppColors` `backgroundDark #0B0F17` + `brand #22D3EE` (9.2:1 contrast) + `surfaceDark #131920` + `glassDark 0x0DFFFFFF` `glassSurface 0x14FFFFFF` `glassBorder 0x1AFFFFFF` + `correctGreen #10B981` `wrongRed #EF4444` `xpGold #EAB308` `coinYellow #FACC15` `streakOrange #F97316` `lifelineCyan #06B6D4` `comboPurple #A855F7` `guildPurple #8B5CF6`; `AppTypography` `InstrumentSans` + `NotoSansDevanagari` 1.8 height; `AppSpacing` 4/8/12/16/24/32 never `Padding(17)`; `AppRadii` 8/12/16/20/24; `AppShadows` `surfaceTint` M3; `AppMotion` 120/180/240/320ms interaction + 800/1200ms celebration; `AppIcons` MaterialSymbols + custom civil SVGs. `AppTheme` M3 `ColorScheme.fromSeed` light/dark `lib/app/theme/app_theme.dart:10`.
**UI Laws (from `mobileapp-design-reserch-flutter.md:1083` + `SOCIAL`):** quiz = one question, one decision, one dominant next action; result = celebrate→explain→improve→continue; course = continue not browse; home = tell what to do next; achievement = celebrate user not company; referral = reward genuine participation not spam. All implemented.
**Components `RESEARCH §65-66`:** 15 `Civil*` shared (`AppButton`, `GlassmorphicCard`, `AmbientGlow`, `NetworkImage 400px max`, `RepaintBoundary`) + 8 quiz (`QuestionCard`, `AnswerOptionTile` 56dp min 44dp touch, `QuizProgressBar`, `QuestionTimer`, `LifelineBar`, `ComboStreakOverlay` top-right compact after 3, `ExplanationCard`, `ResultScoreRing`). `AnswerOptionTile` uses green/amber/violet/gray + icon/shape/border not color-only per WCAG 62.
**Animations `RESEARCH §23`:** `flutter_animate 4.5.0` + `lottie 3.1.3` + `flutter_svg 2.0.12`; `level_up.json` 2.5s auto-dismiss, `achievement_unlock` 4s slide-down + heavy haptic `vibration 3.2.0`, `streak_fire` + `confetti` reduceMotion guard `MediaQuery.disableAnimations`.
**A11y AAA `RESEARCH §24`:** `Semantics` labels per 24.1, `FittedBox` numbers, `excludeSemantics` on decorative glow, `44dp` min, `MediaQuery.textScaler` respect, TalkBack+VoiceOver pass on 5 tabs + quiz play (manual).
**Perf <2s cold <150MB 60fps `RESEARCH §27`:** parallel `Preferences`+`AppDatabase` warm `bootstrap.dart:42` + `tz` + `Firebase` guarded, `flutter_analyze lib` 0, `p95 frame <16ms` quiz via `Timer.periodic` 1Hz `state.copyWith(elapsedSeconds)` only + `ref.watch.select` for navigator circles (not whole widget), `cached_network_image 4.0.0` `maximumSizeBytes 100MB`, `RepaintBoundary` around Lottie, `fl_chart 1.2.0` radar `PaintingBinding.imageCache.maximumSizeBytes=100MB`, `shimmer 4.0.0` skeletons not spinners, `Dart 3.13.2` record+pattern matching for `ApiErrorCode`. Working set <150MB verified via `DevTools` memory, cold <2s via `firebase_performance` traces (planned).

## 7. Library Defer Rationale — Backend Not Ready

`C:\laragon\www\bisaas\routes\api\v1\library.php:20` exists but controllers return stub/404 and `CalculatorCatalogService` etc. show `library` domain not completed per user 2026-08-30. `MOBILE_API_INTEGRATION_GUIDE.md:125` lists `GET /library/files` etc. as mobile-relevant, but `route:list` shows zero live `library` routes beyond the file stub. Building `lib/features/library` now would invent the contract and violate `AGENTS.md:60` `Never add a route that is not in MOBILE_API_INTEGRATION_GUIDE.md or OpenAPI`. **Decision: both agents skip Library; when backend ships `GET /library/files`+`/categories`+`POST /files/{slug}/unlock`+`GET /files/{slug}/download`+`GET /trending`+`GET /recommendations` + `isDomainEnabled` flag, mobile adds `lib/features/library` additive (no breaking change) with `Drift` `library_table` + `ApiCacheHeaders` + `If-None-Match` 304. Cost of skipping: 0 store risk; cost of building now: invented payload → throwaway + `SOCIAL §12` growth loop starved (share-moment API GAP-3).**

## 8. Market Positioning & Moat — Elite Quiz, Duolingo, Regional

**Elite Quiz v2.3.7 audit `D:/QuizDemo/.../elite_quiz_app-2.3.7` (verified via `grep` + `MOBILE_PLAN_SENIOR_REVIEW_2026-08-29.html:200`):** 290 Dart files, CodeIgniter 3 + 56 `tbl_` tables + 6,702-line `Api.php`, `http 1.3.0` (no interceptors), `hive_flutter 1.1.0` (KV, not relational), `flutter_bloc 9.1.1` (5 files/feat), AES-256 answer keyed on `firebaseId+0000` (obfuscation, not encryption), Firestore matchmaking no atomic claim (race), wide `tbl_users_badges` one col per badge (`ALTER TABLE` per badge), `dependency_overrides` pinned `flutter_widget_from_html 0.16` below `^0.17.1`, 213-line `switch` routes + `globalCtx = globalNavigator.currentContext!` `!` before mount, `lib/features/` + `ui/screens/` both live (stalled migration), `SystemConfigModel` 90 fields `int.parse` nullable→crash. **Strengths to steal:** session snapshots for re-grading, dispatch map `set_quiz_coin_score` 12 grading policies, payout gating, settlement idempotency `set_user1/set_user2`, coin ledger `tbl_tracker`, server-driven config+localization (`getBadgeNotificationData` per-lang FCM). **Refuse:** all above anti-patterns; BiSaaS uses `ApiClient` single decode point, `Riverpod` 1-2 files/feat, `Drift` relational, server never ships answers, matchmaking via `POST /quiz/battle-rooms` lock.

**Regional exam-prep apps (Loksewa/PSC):** local banks, coin economies, battles but shallow models, client-authoritative scoring, no calculators, no IRT. **Engineering calculators:** correct math offline but no loop, no progression. BiSaaS sits in **intersection**: 232 calculators + 57 question types + IRT+SM-2 + `StatisticalClaimGuard` honest difficulty `73% missed` + `World Map` `GET /quiz/game/worlds|/world/{slug}/map|/missions/dashboard|/report-card|/league|/ghost` `routes/api/v1/quiz.php:282` + EICE `GET /quiz/study-planner/{exam}/coach|/triage|/sprint|/reports/weekly|/calibration` + Library deferred but not needed for moat. **Tool→learning loop** is defensible: `activity_events` spine `CalculationPerformed` joins `POST /{domain}/{slug}/calculate` history to `GET /learning/today` + `GET /quiz/sprint` — neither quiz-only nor calc-only competitor can build it.

**Duolingo parity → surpass `BISAAS_FLUTTER_COMPLETE_MASTER_PLAN_v1.0.md:1.4`:** streak `GET /quiz/streak` + repair/insurance/wager server (WO-6, display done), sub-100ms optimistic local paint + server `POST /attempts/{a}/answer` reconcile, rarity-tiered celebrations `common/rare/epic/legendary` `AchievementsScreen:1`, `PlayerHUD` XP/coins/streak/level persistent, daily habit `flutter_local_notifications` 8am + FCM `POST /device-tokens`. **Surpass:** honest cohort stats `StatisticalClaimGuard` (starved until `quiz:questions:analyze-performance` WO-14 scheduled — cheapest high-impact item), real tool 232, peer `#42 of 12,000 engineers` guild/league, lossless offline `SyncQueue` idempotency + `Drift` packs.

**UVPs ranked `1.3`:** 1) Tool+learning loop (both products + spine) → live; 2) Honest difficulty (`StatisticalClaimGuard`) → live but starved; 3) Adaptive IRT+SM-2 → live `GET /learning/reviews/due` + `POST /reviews/{r}/grade`; 4) Regional exam authority PSC blueprints → live `POST /psc/blueprints/{b}/exam`; 5) Offline-first low-end Android → `SyncQueue` + `ConnectivityService` + `OfflineStateBanner` (planned `core/sync/background_fetch.dart` midnight `GET /api/mobile/daily-quiz-pack` → Drift); 6) Localized push Nepali/Hindi → `Localization` domain 9 locales + ARB `en/ne/hi` `lib/l10n/` + `NotoSansDevanagari` 1.8 height.

| D1/D7/D30 retention | 55% / 30% / 18% | Firebase Analytics cohorts `AnalyticsService:26` | Growth |
| Median session | ≥7 min | `session_start`/`session_end` | Product |
| Quizzes/active/week | ≥4 | `quiz_completed` | Quiz |
| Streak ≥7 days | 25% of D7 | `GET /quiz/streak` snapshot | Gamification |
| Crash-free | ≥99.5% | Sentry+Crashlytics `bootstrap.dart:56` | Eng |
| Cold start Redmi Note 12 | <2.0s | `firebase_performance` traces | Perf |
| p95 frame quiz | <16ms | DevTools release profile | Perf |
| Offline sync success | ≥99.9% in 24h | `SyncQueue` telemetry `sync_manager:58` | Sync |
| AAB arm64 split | <25 MB | `flutter build appbundle --analyze-size` | Build |
| API error client-attrib | <0.5% | `X-Request-Id` correlation | Network |

**Quality gates `1.7`:** `flutter analyze` 0 with `lib/shared/**` not excluded `analysis_options.yaml:10`, `flutter test` ≥70% overall ≥90% `core/network|sync|security`+repos, `patrol` E2E golden path `launch→login→home→quiz 20Q→lifeline→result→share→progress`, TalkBack+VoiceOver on 5 tabs+quiz, 60fps Redmi Note 12 release, no token/PII in logs `Part 10.6`.

**Founder next 30/60/90 days:**
- **30 days:** Internal track 100 users (Loksewa students), fix `quiz:questions:analyze-performance` schedule, instrument `tool→learning` loop `activity_events` → `GET /learning/today`, run `patrol` screenshots, ASO `fastlane.metadata.md` 80-char title `CivilCal — Loksewa & Engineering Mastery` + Nepali `civilcal` deep links `app_links 6.3.2` verified `assetlinks.json`, `in_app_review` 30-day prompts at quiz 3/10/25 + calc 5/20.
- **60 days:** EICE polish `GET /quiz/study-planner/{exam}/coach` real IRT, `GET /quiz/sprint` SM-2 grade loop `POST /sprint/{q}/grade`, `GET /learning/reviews/due` daily, battery+Data Saver `core/connectivity`, public `GET /quiz/packs` packs (WO-15) + `is_current` checksum, D7→40% via streak 21:00 `LocalNotificationService:37` + `battle_invite` → `/battle/{id}`.
- **90 days:** Library backend ships → `lib/features/library` additive `GET /library/files`+`/categories`+`POST /files/{slug}/unlock`+`GET /files/{slug}/download`+`GET /trending`+`GET /recommendations` + `GET /me/unlocks` + `Drift` `library_table` + `file_service` + `path_provider`; subscription IAP vs web checkout decision + `GET /me` `subscription` ; store premium skins `store` module + `subscription` entitlement; staged rollout 10% 72h health.

## 10. Appendices — Security Matrix, Testing Pyramid, CI/CD, Store ASO

**A. Security Matrix `Part 9` + `task_plan.md:61`:**
- Token: only `flutter_secure_storage` `TokenManager:16` (`auth_token`+`auth_expires_at`+`device_name`), never `SharedPreferences` `lib/core/storage/preferences.dart:10` (theme/locale/onboarding only), 401→refresh single-use rotation `X-Device-Name` `RefreshInterceptor:46` or re-login, `AuthInterceptor:68` never logs JWT, `AppSecurity:1` `isDeviceCompromised()` via `MethodChannel('civilcal/security')` `isRooted` + `auditOrWarn()` `bootstrap:1`, no secret in app `dart_define` `lib/app/config/env.dart:6`.
- Pinning: `CertificatePinning:8` `prodPins:20` SHA-256 `crypto 3.0.3` `pinFor(cert)` `base64(sha256(cert.der))` `sha256/...`, `apply(IOHttpClientAdapter,host)` fail-closed when pins set, dev `bisaas.test`/`10.0.2.2` bypass `DioClient:59-67` only `isDev`, `DioClient:76` `CertificatePinning.apply` else standard validation.
- Attestation: Play Integrity `fastlane` + `GET /app/config` `min_app_version` force-update, no `isPremium` from local, `GET /me` `subscription` server, `EconomyService::debit` ledger `climactic/laravel-credits` + `bavix/wallet` never local mint, `QuizCompleted` event→`playerHudProvider` refetch `RESEARCH 5.9`.
- Errors: `Failures:1` `NetworkFailure`+`CacheFailure`+`ValidationFailure`, `ErrorHandler` `lib/core/errors/error_handler.dart:1` `ApiException→Failure` + `ErrorReporter` `lib/core/errors/error_reporter.dart:1` Sentry breadcrumbs, `RetryInterceptor:14` `Retry-After` http-date parse `HttpDate.parse` + `X-RateLimit-Reset` <60s, exponential `500*2^attempt+jitter 0-250ms`, only `GET|Idempotency-Key` on 5xx.

**B. Testing Pyramid `Part 10` `task_plan.md:61`:** 90% domain, 80% repo, 70% controller, `patrol` E2E `integration_test/app_test.dart:1` golden path `launch→login→home→quiz 20Q→lifeline→result→share→progress` `docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-29-civilcal-flutter-complete.md:389`, `mocktail 1.0.4` for `TokenManager`+`Dio` `MockSecureStorage` `ScriptedAdapter` `ResponseBody.fromString` `lib/core/network/refresh_interceptor_test.dart:25` `retry_idempotency_test.dart`, `very_good_analysis` + `flutter_lints` strict `strict-casts/strict-raw-types`, `test/architecture_test.dart` grep `features/<a>/`→`features/<b>/` fails build, `test/widget_test.dart:7` `ApiConfig baseUrl` + `Accept` + `Env`+`ApiException`. 52 tests now, target 70% line → add `quiz_local_data_source_test` + `home_aggregation_test` + `eice_triage_test` after ship.

**C. CI/CD `lib/app/config/env.dart:6` + `fastlane` + `.github/workflows/`:**
```
flutter pub get
dart run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs # freezed/json/riverpod/drift
flutter gen-l10n # after *.arb edit CI runs too
flutter analyze # 0 issues, `lib/shared/**` not excluded per senior review D4 fix
flutter test --coverage # ≥70% overall ≥90% core/network|sync|security+repos
flutter build appbundle --dart-define=ENV=prod --dart-define-from-file=dart_defines/production.json # fastlane/beta uses same
flutter build apk --dart-define=ENV=prod
patrol -- screenshots `fastlane/screenshots`
```
